questions.Description:
A) Explain the concept of Green Buildings, its definition, aims, environmental impact of buildings and brief history of green building movement with suitable diagrams.
B) Illustrate and explain the five main strategies to achieve green efficiency in buildings with neat sketches

A) Explain site specific design guidelines including purpose of tree cover, vegetative planning, green roofs, cool roofs and cool pavements with diagrams.
B) Describe water efficiency techniques such as grey water recycling, rainwater harvesting methods and reuse guidelines with suitable drawings.

A) Explain guidelines for energy efficiency in buildings with respect to HVAC systems, insulation and smart controls with neat sketches.
B) Illustrate renewable energy generation methods such as solar panels, solar water heating and passive design principles in buildings.

A) Explain properties and uses of green building materials such as CSEB, AAC blocks, fly ash, bamboo, certified wood and recyclable materials.
B) Describe alternative construction techniques including filler slab, rat trap bond, ferrocement components and use of salvaged materials with sketches.

A) Explain indoor environmental quality guidelines including ventilation, daylighting, thermal comfort, low VOC materials and acoustic control.
B) Describe green building rating systems in India and analyse selected green buildings with diagrams.
